slides.texte_overlay:
What to do in the first hour
after work
Make a clear end to the workday. Close the laptop, write tomorrow's top three tasks. A clean finish stops work from following you home.
Move your body first. A walk, a run, the gym. Twenty minutes of movement clears the stress of the day better than the couch.
Shower and change clothes. A simple ritual that tells your brain you're off duty and ready for your own time. It takes five minutes.
Eat a proper meal. Not snacks in front of a screen. A real dinner gives you energy for the rest of the evening. Cook something simple.
Feed your mind with something good. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it's the best switch between work and free time.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It's the best switch between work and free time.

slides.texte_overlay: Call or see someone. A friend, your partner, your family. Ten minutes of real connection lifts your mood more than any series.
Keep the phone away for the first hour. Your evening suddenly feels longer, calmer and much more your own. Try it tomorrow.
